prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright modern rooftop terrace with a pale deck floor, a waist-high glass railing, a standard door and a city skyline in the daylight haze, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, THREE people standing close side by side, shoulder to shoulder in a single row, with just enough spacing that every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back far enough that all three are visible from head to toe, the whole row filling the width of the tall frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Filipina woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, a bright, confident pageant smile, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in a short pixie cut, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large brass hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a copper round bell, a copper square-sided cowbell, a gold miniature anvil, a gold small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a silver ship's anchor, a bronze hammer head, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten gold anklets. LEFT Body Art: Her body carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, great wave formations in DEEP COBALT and STARK WHITE, extreme high-gloss oil finish. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
